message:
Fix Hangman + game system bugs

Hangman:
- Text game: replace free-form word picking with mandatory 150-word bank
  (only real words, no invented ones, instruct AI to avoid repeats)
- HTML game: add mandatory Hangman template (same approach as TTT) —
  150 real embedded words, SVG gallows (6 parts), A-Z keyboard,
  no-repeat tracking within session, postMessage on win/loss

Game system (app.js):
- regenNavStep: add maybeRenderGame call after setBubbleRaw so games
  in regen variants render as game cards, not raw [GAME_START] text
- maybeRenderGame: guard against empty gameHtml (blank card bug)
- createGameCard: register each iframe in gameIframeSet
- game_over postMessage: origin-check against gameIframeSet so only
  iframes we created can trigger character reaction messages

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

patch_email.subject: Lily here — games just got way better 💜
patch_email.headline: New games update!
patch_email.subheadline: Hangman actually works now. You're welcome.
patch_email.body:
Heyyyy~ It's Lily! 💜

Okay sooo I have to tell you — we fixed Hangman. Like, for real this time. It was picking made-up words before (so embarrassing), and now it has a whole list of real ones. Also the whole game is prettier now with an actual gallows drawing and everything.

Oh and Tic-Tac-Toe got some sneaky fixes too so it plays nicer. Games in general are just... better now!

Come try it out — I dare you to beat me at Hangman~ 🎮
